name: Máquina Culona
description: Máquina Culona is a party dedicated to emerging Spanish urban music and avant-pop, hosted at Maus Hábitos in Porto.
longDescription:
Máquina Culona takes place at Maus Hábitos on 28 November 2026, starting at 23:59. The event is dedicated to the emerging Spanish urban music and avant-pop movement.

The venue is located at Rua de Passos Manuel, 178, on the 4th floor. Tickets cost 6€.
descriptionPt: Máquina Culona é uma festa dedicada à música urbana espanhola emergente e à avant-pop, no Maus Hábitos, no Porto.
longDescriptionPt:

O espaço fica na Rua de Passos Manuel, 178, no 4.º andar. Os bilhetes custam 6€.
